schedule.variable: Variable rate: the table applies the current nominal rate to the whole term, so the bank's table will differ when the index moves.
schedule.differsTitle: The table differs from the declared capital
schedule.differs: The schedule gives {{computed}} due on {{date}}, the file says {{declared}}: {{hint}}.
schedule.paymentDiffers: The declared payment does not match the computed instalment.
schedule.paymentDiffersHint: The declared payment does not match the computed instalment: {{hint}}.
schedule.yearNote: The interest of a year is what a mortgage-interest line (IT 730) or a rental-income declaration (FR, for a rental-property loan) asks for: check it against the lender's annual statement before using it.

payments.found: Payments found in the bank data
payments.noLabel: No bank label is recorded for this loan: set it (Edit the loan) to link its payments.
payments.summary_one: {{count}} payment matches /{{pattern}}/, typically <amount/>; the last on {{date}}.
payments.summary_other: {{count}} payments match /{{pattern}}/, typically <amount/>; the last on {{date}}.

scenario.intro: Estimates on this loan's real schedule (capital and instalments left, insurance, deferral). Nothing is changed anywhere; the lender's figures decide.
scenario.label: Scenario
scenario.penaltyMortgageHint: Blank = the legal cap for a French / Italian mortgage; 0 for other loans
scenario.penaltyHint: Blank = the legal cap (FR IRA) or none (IT surroga)
scenario.otherPolicyHint: A dated quote for equivalent guarantees
scenario.nothingLeft: No instalment remains after that date.
scenario.prepaySummary_one: Repaying <amount/> on {{date}}: capital due <before/> → <after/>, {{count}} instalment of <instalment/> left. Penalty <penalty/>: <basis>{{basis}}</basis>
scenario.prepaySummary_other: Repaying <amount/> on {{date}}: capital due <before/> → <after/>, {{count}} instalments of <instalment/> left. Penalty <penalty/>: <basis>{{basis}}</basis>
scenario.renegotiateLine: {{variant}} at {{newRate}} % instead of {{currentRate}} %: instalment <current/> → <next/> (<saving/> less a month).
scenario.renegotiateCosts: Gross interest saving <gross/>, costs <costs/> (penalty <penalty/>: <basis>{{basis}}</basis>), net saving <net/>, break-even {{breakEven}}.
scenario.insuranceLine: Insurance <current/> → <alternative/> a month over {{months}} months: <saving/> a month, net saving <net/> ({{verdict}}).

suggestions.title: Inferred, not recorded
suggestions.intro: These values are worked out from the instalments seen in the bank data with annuity maths. They are never written to your memory: you can queue them as a proposal, check them against the contract, and accept them yourself.
suggestions.empty: Nothing can be suggested yet: two of the amount borrowed, the rate and the term must be known (or the capital still due with its date and the end date).
suggestions.waiting: Proposal {{id}} is waiting in Memory > Proposals. Accepting it is done in a terminal:

lease.reminderActive: The 6-month reminder is active: decide between buying and returning the car.
lease.endUnknown: Record the end date (Edit the loan) to get the buy-or-return reminder 6 months before.
lease.overNoFee: . Record the excess fee to price it.
lease.needs: To project the mileage I still need: {{needs}}.
lease.checklistNote: General checklist: verify the notice period and the return conditions in your own contract.
